title: VISTA: A Visual Harness for Reasoning in an Interactive World
title_zh: VISTA：交互世界中推理的视觉框架

paragraphs.en: We show that multimodal models possess strong reasoning abilities and that an appropriate harness can unlock their potential to solve tasks across diverse interactive environments. We introduce VISTA , a visual harness that gives a general-purpose multimodal model long-horizon vision. VISTA allows the model to directly perceive the environment through visual observations and maintains a lossless visual memory that preserves past observations in their original form. The model can actively retrieve these observations and reorganize its visual input as it reasons. On ARC-AGI-3, VISTA improves Claude Opus 5.0’s Relative Human Action Efficiency score from 40.68 to a perfect 100.00, with the model completing all 25 public games using 57.4% fewer actions than first-time human participants. VISTA’s simple design also allows it to extend naturally to diverse visual environments with minimal adaptation. Across three additional benchmarks covering a diverse range of visual games and puzzles, it substantially outperforms baselines using the same underlying model with minimal harnesses. Our results highlight VISTA’s potential as a general-purpose visual harness for advancing multimodal agents in complex visual environments.

paragraphs.en: We live in a dynamic, high-dimensional world. As humans, we perceive our surroundings, reason about what we observe, and act based on our understanding and past experience [ 56 , 48 ] . However, it remains unclear whether existing artificial intelligence (AI) systems have a similar ability to understand and interact robustly with the world, especially in unfamiliar environments.
paragraphs.zh: 我们生活在一个动态的高维世界中。 作为人类，我们会感知周围环境，对观察到的事物进行推理，并基于我们的理解和过往经验采取行动 [ 56 , 48 ] 。 然而，现有的人工智能（AI）系统是否具备类似的能力——能够稳健地理解并与世界互动，尤其是在不熟悉的环境中——这一点仍然不清楚。

sents.en: However, it remains unclear whether existing artificial intelligence (AI) systems have a similar ability to understand and interact robustly with the world, especially in unfamiliar environments.
sents.zh: 然而，现有的人工智能（AI）系统是否具备类似的能力——能够稳健地理解并与世界互动，尤其是在不熟悉的环境中——这一点仍然不清楚。

paragraphs.en: To study this question, we use ARC-AGI-3 [ 5 ] , a suite of interactive visual games in which an agent needs to discover the rules and goals of unfamiliar worlds through interaction. This benchmark is typically approached as a language-based problem, with large language models (LLMs) receiving a textual or structured representation of the environment, as shown in Figure 1 a. Building on this setup, a common strategy is to use code-based methods that construct a executable world model using symbolic programs [ 62 , 39 , 11 , 25 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 为了研究这个问题，我们使用了 ARC-AGI-3 [ 5 ]，这是一套交互式视觉游戏，其中智能体需要通过互动来发现陌生世界的规则和目标。 这个基准测试通常被当作一个基于语言的问题来处理，大型语言模型（LLM）会接收环境的文本或结构化表示，如圖 1 a 所示。 在此基础上，一种常见的策略是使用基于代码的方法，通过符号程序构建可执行的世界模型 [ 62 , 39 , 11 , 25 ]。

paragraphs.en: We instead reframe ARC-AGI-3 as a vision-based problem and address it using multimodal models. However, as illustrated in Figure 1 b, existing vision-language models (VLMs) typically encode each image once into visual representations [ 2 , 28 ] . These representations may not preserve the details needed as reasoning evolves. Moreover, earlier observations may be removed from the context or replaced by textual summaries to stay within the model’s context limit [ 29 , 36 , 27 ] . These limitations may constrain the models’ reasoning capabilities during long-horizon interactions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们转而将 ARC-AGI-3 重新定义为一个基于视觉的问题，并使用多模态模型来解决它。 然而，如图 1 b 所示，现有的视觉语言模型（VLM）通常仅对每张图片进行一次编码，生成视觉表示 [ 2 , 28 ] 。 这些表示可能无法保留推理过程演变所需的细节。 此外，为了保持在模型的上下文限制内，早期的观察结果可能会被从上下文中移除，或被文本摘要所取代 [ 29 , 36 , 27 ] 。 这些局限性可能会在长期交互过程中限制模型的推理能力。

paragraphs.en: To this end, we introduce VISTA , a visual harness that allows the model to actively reorganize its visual input during long-horizon interactions (Figure 1 c). The model receives visual observations of the environment that preserve the appearance and spatial relations of objects. It develops its understanding of the environment through free-form language reasoning [ 55 , 42 ] and uses this understanding to predict action outcomes and plan subsequent actions [ 59 ] . Instead of relying solely on visual representations retained in the model’s context, which may be compressed, lossy, and insufficient for subsequent reasoning, VISTA maintains a lossless visual memory . This memory stores every frame returned by the environment, including intermediate animation frames, in its original form. The model can retrieve observations from this memory through visual inspection , selecting frames to compare and spatial regions to examine at different levels of detail based on its current reasoning needs [ 48 , 47 ] . Figure 2 shows two example agent trajectories with VISTA, illustrating how observation, reasoning, inspection, and action are interleaved.
paragraphs.zh: 为此，我们引入了 VISTA——一种视觉框架，它使模型能够在长期交互过程中主动重组其视觉输入（图 1c）。 模型接收对环境的视觉观察结果，这些结果保留了物体的外观和空间关系。 它通过自由形式的语言推理 [55, 42] 来建立对环境的理解，并利用这种理解预测行动结果并规划后续行动 [59]。 VISTA 不会仅仅依赖模型上下文中保留的视觉表示——这些表示可能经过压缩、存在信息损失且不足以支持后续推理——而是会维护一个无损的视觉记忆。 该记忆以原始形式存储环境返回的每一帧画面，包括中间动画帧。 模型可以通过视觉检查从该记忆中检索观察结果：根据当前的推理需求，选择需要比较的画面和需要以不同细节级别检查的空间区域 [48, 47]。 图 2 展示了使用 VISTA 的两个智能体轨迹示例，说明了观察、推理、检查和行动如何交错进行。

paragraphs.en: With VISTA, Claude Opus 5.0 [ 3 ] completes all 25 public ARC-AGI-3 games with a Relative Human Action Efficiency (RHAE) score of 100.00 with xhigh reasoning effort, using 57.4% fewer actions than the first-time human baseline. VISTA with GPT-5.6 Sol [ 33 ] likewise completes all 25 games, achieving an RHAE score of 99.00 with max reasoning effort. To our knowledge, VISTA is the first vision-based system to achieve perfect or near-perfect performance on ARC-AGI-3 without program synthesis. For comparison, the organizers’ official baselines, which also do not use programs, achieve RHAE scores of 40.68 with Opus 5.0 high and 13.33 with GPT-5.6 Sol max [ 7 , 34 ] .

paragraphs.en: The simplicity of VISTA also allows it to extend naturally to other visual environments with minimal adaptation. We apply the same visual harness to 34 browser games from GameWorld [ 35 ] , 10 browser games from AI GameStore [ 60 ] , and 39 visual tracking problems from BabyVision [ 12 ] . Together, these benchmarks cover a wide range of games and visual reasoning tasks that require skills such as complex reasoning, spatial navigation, and strategic planning. GPT-5.6 Sol with VISTA substantially outperforms baselines that use the same model with minimal harnesses. It also outperforms the novice human baseline on GameWorld and the human median baseline on AI GameStore. Overall, these results demonstrate VISTA’s effectiveness across diverse visual environments and highlight visual harness design as an important direction for improving multimodal agents.

paragraphs.en: ARC-AGI-1 [ 16 ] and ARC-AGI-2 [ 14 ] are benchmarks designed to evaluate abstract reasoning over static input–output grids [ 15 ] . Approaches to these benchmarks often use pretrained large language models [ 8 , 1 , 19 , 37 , 26 , 9 ] , recurrent models [ 50 , 23 ] , or vision-based models [ 22 ] . ARC-AGI-3 [ 5 ] makes this setting interactive: an agent must explore novel environments, adapt continuously from its interactions, and take actions to achieve its goals [ 24 ] . Existing approaches to ARC-AGI-3 largely rely on program synthesis [ 62 , 25 , 11 , 39 , 40 ] , in which agents perceive the environment through textual or symbolic representations and abstract it into programs that can be executed, verified, and searched over to guide actions. While effective on ARC-AGI-3, these approaches rely on constructing explicit programmatic abstractions of the environment. As environments become more visually complex, representing their states, transition dynamics, and goal conditions with explicit programs may become increasingly difficult. In contrast, VISTA operates directly on visual observations and reasons in natural language.
paragraphs.zh: ARC-AGI-1 [ 16 ] 和 ARC-AGI-2 [ 14 ] 是用于评估静态输入–输出网格中抽象推理能力的基准测试 [ 15 ] 。 针对这些基准测试的方法通常使用预训练的大型语言模型 [ 8 , 1 , 19 , 37 , 26 , 9 ] 、循环模型 [ 50 , 23 ] 或基于视觉的模型 [ 22 ] 。 ARC-AGI-3 [ 5 ] 使这一设定变为交互式：智能体必须探索新环境，通过交互持续适应，并采取行动以实现其目标 [ 24 ] 。 现有针对 ARC-AGI-3 的方法主要依赖程序合成 [ 62 , 25 , 11 , 39 , 40 ] ，其中智能体通过文本或符号表示感知环境，并将其抽象为可执行、验证和搜索的程序，以指导行动。 尽管这些方法在 ARC-AGI-3 上效果显著，但它们依赖于构建环境的显式程序化抽象。 随着环境在视觉上变得更为复杂，使用显式程序来表示其状态、转换动态和目标条件可能会变得越来越困难。 相比之下，VISTA 直接对视觉观察结果进行操作，并以自然语言进行推理。

paragraphs.en: Recent work has explored agents that interact with computers and graphical user interfaces to complete complex tasks. Existing approaches broadly differ in their observation space. Text-based approaches operate over structured representations of the interface, such as HTML, DOM trees, accessibility trees, or element identifiers, and use language models to reason over these representations and take symbolic actions [ 32 , 17 , 64 ] . Vision-based computer-use agents interact directly with screenshots and take grounded actions such as clicks, mouse movements, and keyboard inputs [ 13 , 57 , 38 , 52 , 30 ] . VISTA follows the vision-based paradigm: the agent reasons directly from visual observations rather than textual or symbolic representations of the environment. It focuses on a visual-centric harness for reasoning in interactive worlds and provides a simple interface for agents to observe and interact with the environment.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的研究探索了能够与计算机和图形用户界面互动以完成复杂任务的智能体。 现有方法在观察空间方面存在显著差异。 基于文本的方法通过结构化表示的界面（如 HTML、DOM 树、无障碍树或元素标识符）进行操作，并利用语言模型对这些表示进行推理并执行符号化操作 [ 32 , 17 , 64 ] 。 基于视觉的计算机使用智能体直接与屏幕截图互动，并执行点击、鼠标移动和键盘输入等具体操作 [ 13 , 57 , 38 , 52 , 30 ] 。 VISTA 遵循基于视觉的范式：智能体直接从视觉观察结果中进行推理，而非依赖环境的文本或符号化表示。 它专注于一种以视觉为中心的交互式世界推理框架，并为智能体提供了一个简单界面，用于观察环境并与之互动。

paragraphs.en: Games have long served as testbeds for developing agents that learn to perceive, reason, and act in interactive environments. Classical approaches learn policies through reinforcement learning [ 31 , 43 , 44 ] or learn environment dynamics to support prediction and planning [ 41 , 21 ] . While these methods provide general learning algorithms, they typically require training a separate agent for each game. More recently, foundation models have enabled more general-purpose agents that operate in richer game environments. Voyager uses a large language model together with structured Minecraft observations and an executable skill library [ 51 ] , while JARVIS-1 incorporates visual observations and retrieves similar past experiences for planning in Minecraft [ 53 ] . Generalist agents such as SIMA and SIMA 2 [ 46 , 45 ] , Cradle [ 49 ] , and Game-TARS [ 54 ] further operate directly from visual observations across multiple environments. A central challenge in these systems is retaining information over long interaction horizons: prior agents typically maintain only a bounded visual context or selectively store and compress past experiences. VISTA instead preserves the complete visual interaction history losslessly and allows the agent to actively revisit arbitrary previous frames and regions during reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 游戏长期以来一直是开发智能体的试验场，这些智能体能够学会在交互式环境中感知、推理和行动。 传统方法通过强化学习来学习策略 [ 31 , 43 , 44 ]，或者学习环境动态以支持预测和规划 [ 41 , 21 ]。 尽管这些方法提供了通用的学习算法，但它们通常需要为每款游戏单独训练一个智能体。 近期，基础模型催生了更具通用性的智能体，使其能够在更丰富的游戏环境中运行。 Voyager 使用大型语言模型结合结构化的 Minecraft 观察数据和可执行技能库 [ 51 ]，而 JARVIS-1 则整合了视觉观察数据，并检索类似的过往经验以在 Minecraft 中进行规划 [ 53 ]。 SIMA 和 SIMA 2 [ 46 , 45 ]、Cradle [ 49 ] 以及 Game-TARS [ 54 ] 等通用型智能体则能直接从多个环境中的视觉观察数据出发进行运行。 这些系统面临的一个核心挑战是在长时间交互过程中保留信息：以往的智能体通常仅维护有限的视觉上下文，或选择性地存储和压缩过往经验。 相比之下，VISTA 能够无损地保存完整的视觉交互历史，并允许智能体在推理过程中主动回溯任意先前的帧和区域。

paragraphs.en: VISTA lets the model directly perceive the environment through visual inputs. However, existing multimodal systems typically encode visual observations once and discard the raw inputs. As the context fills, these representations may be removed or replaced by textual summaries, and the model may not control what is retained. More importantly, the model may not know at encoding time which visual information will matter later: a representation sufficient at one stage may omit details required in subsequent reasoning steps.
paragraphs.zh: VISTA 让模型能够通过视觉输入直接感知环境。 然而，现有的多模态系统通常只将视觉观察结果编码一次，然后丢弃原始输入。 随着上下文内容的填充，这些表示可能会被文本摘要取代或替换，而模型可能无法控制哪些内容会被保留。 更重要的是，在编码阶段，模型可能并不知道哪些视觉信息在后续阶段会重要：某个阶段足够用的表示，可能会遗漏后续推理步骤所需的细节。

paragraphs.en: These limitations directly motivate the design of VISTA, which preserves original observations in a lossless visual memory and provides tools for the model to retrieve and inspect them during interaction. This allows the model to revisit visual evidence and reorganize its visual input as it reasons, without requiring all relevant information to be captured in the initial visual encoding and retained in the model’s context.
paragraphs.zh: 这些局限性直接促成了 VISTA 的设计：它将原始观察信息无损地保留在视觉记忆中，并为模型提供了在交互过程中检索和检查这些信息所需的工具。 这使得模型能够在推理过程中重新审视视觉证据并重组其视觉输入，而无需将所有相关信息都包含在初始的视觉编码中并在模型上下文中保留下来。

sents.en: This allows the model to revisit visual evidence and reorganize its visual input as it reasons, without requiring all relevant information to be captured in the initial visual encoding and retained in the model’s context.
sents.zh: 这使得模型能够在推理过程中重新审视视觉证据并重组其视觉输入，而无需将所有相关信息都包含在初始的视觉编码中并在模型上下文中保留下来。

paragraphs.en: We introduce three key visual harness components: visual observations , which allows the agent to perceive the environment through rendered images; lossless visual memory , which preserves visual observations in their original form; and visual inspection , which allows the model to revisit visual evidence and examine details as needed. Together, these components provide the model with an explicit attention mechanism over the interaction history, allowing it to select which frames and regions to examine during reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 我们介绍了三种关键的视觉约束组件：视觉观察，它使智能体能够通过渲染后的图像感知环境；无损视觉记忆，它以原始形式保存视觉观察；以及视觉检查，它允许模型重新查看视觉证据并根据需要检查细节。 这些组件共同为模型提供了对交互历史的显式注意力机制，使其能够在推理过程中选择要检查的帧和区域。

paragraphs.en: The model receives visual observations from the environment (Figure. 3 a). These observations preserve the appearance and spatial relation of objects, allowing the model to use its learned visual priors to interpret and reason about the environment.
paragraphs.zh: 该模型接收来自环境中的视觉观察信息（图 3a）。 这些观察信息保留了物体的外观和空间关系，使模型能够利用其已学习的视觉先验知识来解释环境并对环境进行推理。

paragraphs.en: The harness stores every frame returned by the environment, including intermediate animation frames, in its original form (Figure. 3 b). paragraphs.en: Building on the visual memory, we provide the agent with tools to actively inspect visual information in space and across time (Figure 3 c). In space , it can request an enlarged view of any rectangular region from the original frame, allowing it to examine fine-grained details that may be difficult to perceive in the full image. Across time , it can retrieve and inspect multiple frames from arbitrary earlier turns to revisit past visual evidence, compare states, and replay how an action unfolded through its intermediate animation frames. At each turn, the model is free to decide whether to inspect its visual memory and which frames or regions to examine.
paragraphs.zh: 在视觉记忆的基础上，我们为智能体提供了工具，使其能够主动检查空间和时间维度上的视觉信息（图 3c）。 在空间维度上，它可以请求对原始图像中任意矩形区域进行放大显示，从而能够检查在全局图像中可能难以察觉的精细细节。 在时间维度上，它可以检索并检查任意早期回合中的多个帧，以重新审视过去的视觉证据、比较不同状态，并回放某个动作通过中间动画帧逐步展开的过程。 在每个回合中，模型都可以自由决定是否要检查其视觉记忆，以及具体要检查哪些帧或区域。

paragraphs.en: In our pipeline, the model and the harness interact through a multi-turn conversation (Figure 2 ). The harness is purely mechanical and does not involve any trained model: it executes tool calls requested by the model, returns outputs such as images or pixel values, and reports errors for invalid requests. The model reasons over these outputs and issues its next request to the harness if needed.
paragraphs.zh: 在我们的流程中，模型与工具通过多轮对话进行交互（图 2）。 该工具完全由机械逻辑构成，不涉及任何训练好的模型：它执行模型请求的工具调用，返回图像或像素值等输出，并在请求无效时报告错误。 模型会基于这些输出进行推理，并在必要时向工具发出下一个请求。

paragraphs.en: A single agent interacts with each game throughout the run. Each game turn may include multiple exchanges with the harness before the agent executes one game action (Figure 3 d). At the start of a turn, the agent receives the current visual state and available actions. It can also consult two notes that it maintains: GUIDE.md , which records its understanding of the game and information that may remain useful across levels, and WORKING.md , which serves as a scratchpad for the current state. Through inspect , the agent can revisit earlier observations, including intermediate animation frames produced by its previous actions. It can also use read_pixels to examine pixel values within a selected region. Consulting the notes and using the inspection tools are optional and left to the agent’s decision.
paragraphs.zh: 在整个运行过程中，单个智能体与每场游戏进行交互。 每轮游戏可能包含与框架的多次交换，之后智能体才会执行一个游戏动作（图 3d）。 在新一轮开始时，智能体会接收到当前的视觉状态和可用动作。 它还可以查阅自己维护的两份笔记：GUIDE.md，用于记录其对游戏的理解以及可能在不同关卡间持续有用的信息；以及 WORKING.md，用作当前状态的临时草稿。 通过 inspect，智能体可以重新查看早期的观察结果，包括其先前动作产生的中间动画帧。 它还可以使用 read_pixels 来检查所选区域内像素的值。 查阅笔记和使用检查工具均为可选操作，由智能体自行决定。

paragraphs.en: The agent uses free-form language to reason and plan. It predicts the outcome of its planned action, revises its notes to reflect its updated understanding of the environment, and calls play to execute the chosen action and advance to the next game turn. When its context approaches the limit, the agent writes a concise handoff summary and resumes from the current state in a fresh context. Its notes ( GUIDE.md and WORKING.md ), visual memory, and action history remain available.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体使用自由形式语言进行推理和规划。 它会预测所规划行动的结果，更新笔记以反映对环境的新理解，然后调用 play 来执行所选行动并进入下一游戏回合。 当其上下文接近限制时，智能体会撰写一份简洁的交接摘要，并从当前状态在全新的上下文中重新开始。 它的笔记（GUIDE.md 和 WORKING.md）、视觉记忆以及行动历史仍然可用。

paragraphs.en: ARC-AGI-3 [ 5 ] consists of interactive visual games whose rules and objectives are not provided explicitly. We evaluate on the 25 public games. At each step, the agent observes the current visual state, selects an available action, and uses the resulting observation to infer object roles, transition rules, hidden states, and possible goals. Each game contains multiple levels that share underlying mechanics while introducing new concepts, objects, layouts, or constraints. The agent therefore needs to retain and apply previously inferred knowledge across levels while continually adapting its understanding through interaction. Figure 4 shows an example agent trajectory.
paragraphs.zh: ARC-AGI-3 [ 5 ] 由交互式视觉游戏组成，这些游戏的规则和目标并未明确给出。 我们在 25 款公开游戏中进行了评估。 在每个步骤中，智能体观察当前的视觉状态，选择一个可用的动作，并利用由此产生的观察结果来推断物体角色、转换规则、隐藏状态和可能的目标。 每款游戏都包含多个关卡，这些关卡共享底层机制，同时引入了新的概念、物体、布局或约束条件。 因此，智能体需要在不同关卡之间保留并应用之前推断出的知识，同时通过互动不断调整其理解。 图 4 展示了一个智能体轨迹的示例。

paragraphs.en: Performance is measured by Relative Human Action Efficiency (RHAE) [ 4 ] , which compares an agent’s action efficiency with that of first-time human players. A completed level receives 100% credit when its action count matches the human baseline, up to 115% when it uses fewer actions, and partial credit when it uses more actions. Unfinished levels receive zero credit. Later levels receive greater weight, and each game score is capped by the weighted fraction of levels completed. See Appendix A.3 for details.
paragraphs.zh: 性能通过相对人类行动效率（Relative Human Action Efficiency，RHAE）[4] 来衡量，该指标将智能体的行动效率与首次参与的人类玩家的行动效率进行比较。 当完成关卡的行动次数与人类基准一致时，可获得 100% 的积分；若行动次数更少，则最多可获得 115% 的积分；若行动次数更多，则仅获得部分积分。 未完成关卡无法获得任何积分。 后续关卡的权重更高，每局游戏的最终得分由已通关关卡的加权比例决定，且存在上限限制。 详见附录 A.3。

paragraphs.en: Most of the compared systems come from concurrent work. These systems typically represent observations as text-based numerical grids and often reason using a code-based world model: the agent abstracts the environment into symbolic programs that can be executed and checked during exploration. To our knowledge, VISTA is the first system to achieve perfect or near-perfect performance on ARC-AGI-3 without program synthesis . For comparison, the same model scores only 40.68 under the official implementation. In Figure 6 , we also compare textual grids with our default image observations. We find that visual observations achieve comparable performance with fewer actions while using significantly fewer tokens.
paragraphs.zh: 大多数被比较的系统都来自同步进行的研究工作。 这些系统通常将观察结果表示为基于文本的数值网格，并经常使用基于代码的世界模型进行推理：智能体将环境抽象为符号化程序，这些程序可以在探索过程中执行和验证。 据我们所知，VISTA 是首个无需程序合成即可在 ARC-AGI-3 上实现完美或接近完美性能的系统。 作为对比，同一模型在官方实现下的得分仅为 40.68。 在图 6 中，我们还比较了文本网格与我们的默认图像观察结果。 我们发现，视觉观察以更少的动作实现了相当的性能，同时使用的标记数量也显著更少。

paragraphs.en: We compare GPT-5.6 Sol under progressively richer harness configurations in Figure 5 . The official implementation uses textual grids and has a reported RHAE score of 13.33 with 10,619 actions [ 7 , 34 ] . Replacing these textual grids with rendered PNG images (i) increases the score to 47.32, demonstrating the importance of visual observations. The low action count is partly due to runs reaching the action or time limit before completing the games, as suggested by the low completion rate in this configuration. Increasing the action and time limits improves the score to 51.66 (ii). In (iii), we introduce a minimal agent harness that maintains a continuous conversation and uses native compaction to continue beyond its context limit, improving the score to 65.82. Configuration (iv) adds two note files, GUIDE.md and WORKING.md , along with instructions encouraging the agent to build a compact and revisable model of the game, further improving the score to 70.05 (see the prompt in Appendix A.5 ). Finally, configurations (v)–(vi) introduce VISTA’s key visual harness components: adding lossless visual memory and model-directed inspection (v) improves the score to 94.10, while exact pixel readout (vi), which provides numerical RGB values for selected pixels, completes the VISTA harness and increases the score to 99.00.

paragraphs.en: Prior approaches to ARC-AGI-3 commonly represent each frame as a textual grid, encoding observations as rows of integer color indices [ 62 , 39 , 11 , 25 ] . In contrast, VISTA reasons directly from rendered images. We ablate this design choice by replacing VISTA’s image observations with textual grids while keeping the rest of the harness unchanged. As shown in Figure 6 , using textual grids maintains comparable performance but slightly increases the total number of actions. paragraphs.en: The key components of the VISTA harness are lossless visual memory and visual inspection, which allow the agent to revisit stored visual information at any point during interaction. These components provide a form of explicit attention over interaction history. Here, we show qualitative examples of how agents benefit from this re-attention mechanism. Figure 10 a illustrates re-attention across space and time. The agent revisits earlier frames to recover information that is no longer visible in its current observation. In this example, it inspects frames from different points in the trajectory and integrates their information to reconstruct the overall map. Figure 10 b illustrates re-attention to local visual details. The agent selectively zooms into a small region of a stored observation to determine a block’s orientation, which is difficult to see clearly in the full 512 × 512 512\times 512 frame. Together, these examples illustrate two complementary forms of re-attention enabled by lossless visual memory: integrating visual evidence across the interaction history and inspecting local details at the granularity required by the current task.
paragraphs.zh: VISTA 框架的关键组成部分是无损视觉记忆和视觉检查，这使得智能体可以在交互过程中的任何时刻重新查看已存储的视觉信息。 这些组件为交互历史提供了一种显式的注意力机制。 在此，我们展示了智能体如何从这种重新注意机制中受益的定性示例。 图 10a 说明了跨空间和时间范围的重新注意过程。 智能体通过重新查看早期的帧来恢复当前观察中已不可见的信息。 在此示例中，它会检查轨迹中不同时间点的帧，并整合这些信息以重建整体地图。 图 10b 说明了针对局部视觉细节的重新注意过程。 智能体选择性地放大存储观察中的一个小区域，以确定某个区块的方向，而这一方向在完整的 512 × 512 帧中难以清晰辨认。 这些示例共同展示了无损视觉记忆所支持的两种互补的重新注意形式：整合整个交互历史中的视觉证据，以及以当前任务所需的精细程度检查局部细节。

paragraphs.en: VISTA’s general-purpose design allows us to naturally apply the same visual harness to other benchmarks with minimal adaptation. We evaluate VISTA on two interactive game benchmarks: GameWorld [ 35 ] and AI GameStore [ 60 ] . We also evaluate on a static visual reasoning benchmark, BabyVision [ 12 ] , to examine the role of visual inspection without interaction with a dynamic environment. For each benchmark, we compare VISTA with the official implementation using the same model. We also report human performance and the best previously reported result as references. See Appendices A.3 and A.6 for details. Figure 11 shows an overview of these environments. Appendix Figure 14 shows example VISTA trajectories on both interactive and static tasks.

paragraphs.en: GameWorld [ 35 ] contains 34 browser games with 170 tasks across five genres: arcade, platformer, puzzle, runner, and simulation. The agent receives only the official task prompt, available controls, and screenshots. We evaluate VISTA using the computer-use interface, through which the agent interacts with the games directly via keyboard and mouse actions. We report success rate (SR), defined as the fraction of the 170 tasks completed, and progress (PG), which also credits partial completion. Both metrics are computed by the benchmark’s official evaluator.
paragraphs.zh: GameWorld [ 35 ] 包含 34 款浏览器游戏，涵盖五个类型：街机、平台跳跃、解谜、跑酷和模拟，共涉及 170 项任务。 智能体仅能接收到官方任务提示、可用操作选项以及屏幕截图。 我们通过计算机操作界面评估 VISTA，智能体可通过该界面直接使用键盘和鼠标操作与游戏互动。 我们报告成功率（SR），定义为完成 170 项任务中的比例，以及进度（PG），后者也会将部分完成的情况计入评分。 两项指标均由基准测试的官方评估器计算得出。

paragraphs.en: AI GameStore [ 60 ] contains 10 public browser games. The agent receives only the public game description, controls, and visual observations. Through interaction, it must infer the game dynamics and determine how to achieve the objectives. Each game uses its own scoring system. paragraphs.en: VISTA shows that a simple visual harness can unlock the potential of existing multimodal models to complete complex tasks in interactive visual environments. It provides the model with raw visual observations, preserves them in a lossless visual memory, and allows the model to revisit past visual experience at the original level of detail during interaction. We show that this simple design is sufficient for the agent to complete all 25 public ARC-AGI-3 games with a perfect score. The same harness extends naturally to other environments covering a diverse set of visual games and puzzles, with minimal adaptation. Overall, VISTA’s simple design and strong performance across diverse benchmarks suggest its potential as a general-purpose harness for tasks beyond games. Future work could evaluate VISTA on more complex and realistic tasks, such as embodied tasks in environments that more closely resemble the physical world [ 10 ] .
paragraphs.zh: VISTA 表明，一个简单的视觉框架就能释放现有多模态模型的潜力，使其能够在交互式视觉环境中完成复杂任务。 该框架为模型提供原始视觉观察结果，将其无损地存储于视觉记忆中，并允许模型在交互过程中以原有的细节级别重新审视过去的视觉经验。 我们证明，这一简单的设计足以让智能体在所有 25 款公开的 ARC-AGI-3 游戏中获得满分。 同一框架经过极小程度的调整，即可自然地扩展到其他环境，涵盖多种多样的视觉游戏和谜题。 总体而言，VISTA 的简单设计及其在多样化基准测试中的出色表现，表明其有望成为处理游戏以外任务的全能型框架。 未来的研究可以在更复杂、更真实的任务上评估 VISTA，例如在更接近物理世界的环境中执行具身任务 [ 10 ]。

paragraphs.en: (i): Image observations. We first replace the textual grid observations with rendered images. This leads to an RHAE score of 47.32, demonstrating the importance of visual observations. We hypothesize that improved token efficiency contributes to this gain: each image observation requires approximately 308 image tokens, compared with roughly 4K text tokens for an equivalent 64 × 64 64\times 64 textual grid. A request containing seven frames therefore uses roughly 28K tokens for textual observations, compared with about 2.2K for images. Image observations leave more of the model’s limited context window available for reasoning within each request.

paragraphs.en: (ii) → \rightarrow (iii): Continuous conversation. We next allow the agent to interact with the environment through a continuous conversation. Our setting allows multiple play calls within the same conversation and uses native context compaction when the context limit is reached. paragraphs.zh: (ii) → \rightarrow (iii): 连续对话。 接下来，我们允许智能体通过连续对话与环境进行交互。 在官方实现中，每次模型请求最多产生一个环境动作，并且交互历史会在下一次请求时再次提供。 当该历史超过上下文限制时，最旧的交互会被截断，仅保留最近经历的滑动窗口。 我们的设置允许在同一次对话中进行多次调用，并在达到上下文限制时使用原生的上下文压缩功能。 这保留了早期交互的压缩表示，使得过往回合的信息仍可用于后续推理。

paragraphs.en: (iii) → \rightarrow (iv): Add notes. We introduce a minimal memory mechanism by adding two note files: GUIDE.md and WORKING.md . paragraphs.en: A single host-side controller handles all tool calls. The controller maintains the environment connection, archived frames, GUIDE.md , and WORKING.md , and is the only component allowed to advance the game. It also enforces sequential interaction: a new play call is accepted only after the result of the previous action has been returned to the agent. Each returned image is labeled with its turn and frame index. Claude Code receives these images directly in the MCP result. In our Codex integration, tool outputs are text-only, and the controller provides the corresponding images separately as part of the same turn.

paragraphs.en: The organizers’ study involved 486 participants from the general public with diverse demographics. Participants were not selected for specialized training or skills [ ARC Prize Foundation, 2026b ] . Each game was tested by ten participants encountering it for the first time, without task-specific instructions. Testing took place in 90-minute sessions, with a soft time limit of 20 minutes and a hard cutoff of 30 minutes per game. A game was included only if at least two participants independently completed all levels. For each level, the official RHAE human baseline is the upper-median action count among first-time human players who completed that level [ ARC Prize Foundation, 2026a ] .
paragraphs.zh: 组织方的研究涉及了来自普通公众的 486 名参与者，他们的人口统计学特征多样化。 参与者并未因具备专门训练或技能而被选中 [ARC Prize Foundation, 2026b]。 每款游戏都由十名首次接触该游戏的参与者进行测试，且不提供与任务相关的特定说明。 测试以每次 90 分钟的形式进行，每款游戏设有 20 分钟的软性时间限制和 30 分钟的硬性截止时间。 只有当至少两名参与者能够独立完成所有关卡时，该游戏才会被纳入研究。 对于每个关卡，官方的 RHAE 人类基准是首次参与的人类玩家中完成该关卡者的行动次数上四分位值 [ARC Prize Foundation, 2026a]。

paragraphs.en: GameWorld reports results for two human players, both computer science graduate students, each of whom attempted all 170 tasks under the same budget of 100 actions per task as the agents [ Ouyang et al., 2026 ] . The novice player had no prior exposure to the games or tasks, while the expert player had studied the rules and practiced the controls beforehand. We use the novice player’s performance as our reference for first-time human play.

paragraphs.en: We repeat our main evaluations three times to measure run-to-run variation. On ARC-AGI-3, VISTA with GPT-5.6 Sol at maximum reasoning effort achieves RHAE scores of 99.00, 98.90, and 99.23 across the three runs, corresponding to 99.04 ± 0.17 99.04\pm 0.17 (mean ± \pm standard deviation). On GameWorld, the three runs achieve success rates of 64.7%, 64.7%, and 60.6%, and progress scores of 81.0%, 80.0%, and 76.9%, corresponding to 63.33 ± 2.37 63.33\pm 2.37 % success rate and 79.30 ± 2.14 79.30\pm 2.14 % progress. On BabyVision, the three runs achieve 61.5%, 61.5%, and 66.7%, corresponding to 63.23 ± 3.00 63.23\pm 3.00 %.
paragraphs.zh: 我们重复进行三次主要评估，以衡量不同运行之间的差异。 在 ARC-AGI-3 数据集上，VISTA 搭配 GPT-5.6 Sol 并在最大推理努力下，三次运行的 RHAE 分数分别为 99.00、98.90 和 99.23，对应均值为 99.04 ± 0.17 99.04\pm 0.17（均值 ± \pm 标准差）。 在 GameWorld 数据集上，三次运行的成功率分别为 64.7%、64.7% 和 60.6%，进步分数分别为 81.0%、80.0% 和 76.9%，对应成功率为 63.33 ± 2.37 63.33\pm 2.37 %，进步分数为 79.30 ± 2.14 79.30\pm 2.14 %。 在 BabyVision 数据集上，三次运行的结果分别为 61.5%、61.5% 和 66.7%，对应均值为 63.23 ± 3.00 63.23\pm 3.00 %。

paragraphs.en: For AI Game Store, the three runs obtain aggregate scores of 119.99, 148.58, and 140.06. We follow the benchmark’s official multi-run evaluation protocol rather than averaging these three final aggregate scores directly: for each game, we first average its raw score across the three runs, and then apply the benchmark’s normalization and aggregation procedure to these per-game means.
